workerResourceSchema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS worker_resource_access (worker TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES workers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
warehouses TEXT CHECK(warehouses IS NULL OR (json_valid(warehouses) AND json_type(warehouses)='array')),
accounts TEXT CHECK(accounts IS NULL OR (json_valid(accounts) AND json_type(accounts)='array')));
getWorkerResources: SELECT warehouses,accounts FROM worker_resource_access WHERE worker=@id
invalidWorkerResources: WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(a.warehouses) WHERE type<>'text' OR value='')
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(a.accounts) WHERE type<>'text' OR value='') LIMIT 1
scopeStockReceipt: SELECT warehouse_id AS warehouse,account_id AS account FROM stock_receipts WHERE id=@id
scopeReceipt: SELECT account_id AS account FROM receipts WHERE id=@id
scopeExpense: SELECT account_id AS account FROM expenses WHERE id=@id
scopeTransfer: SELECT source_account_id AS account,target_account_id AS targetAccount FROM transfers WHERE id=@id
scopeSale: SELECT warehouse,account FROM sales WHERE id=@id
scopeStockLot: SELECT warehouse FROM sale_stock WHERE id=@id
